quote: Ships at a distance have every man’s wish on board.
source: Zora Neale Hurston, Their Eyes Were Watching God, chapter 1, the opening sentence (1937)

evidence.where: The Zora Neale Hurston estate's official site, excerpt page for Their Eyes Were Watching God, which opens with this sentence; corroborated by a web search returning the same wording as the novel's first sentence from many independent sources
evidence.edition: J. B. Lippincott, 1937 (still in copyright, so no full text was consulted; the estate excerpt carries the opening verbatim)

reason: The estate's own excerpt page gives the novel's opening as this sentence, word for word; it is one of the best known first lines in American fiction and no variant wording is in circulation. Not shipped, person not at cap, not banned, not on the misattribution list.
